title: Queue bounded tenant in-app attention for persistent capability drift

phases.objective: Fan out only persistent high/critical tenant-visible capability blockers into the existing in-app notification outbox, using active tenant membership authority and bounded fail-closed target resolution without external delivery or duplicate alert storage.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A tenant-visible capability blocker that remains unresolved for at least 24 hours and is effectively high/critical queues one tenant-bound in-app outbox intent per active tenant with active membership, while inactive tenants, premature blockers, resolved alerts, over-cap target sets, email/webhook delivery, and external sends remain excluded.
steps: Persist and age-escalate the global tenant-visible capability alert through the existing operational_alerts lifecycle.
Evaluate capability notification eligibility from the persisted severity and persisted age_escalation evidence rather than the pre-upsert live snapshot.
Resolve distinct targets only from memberships joined to tenants where both membership and tenant are active.
Bound the target query at max_tenant_targets plus one and fail closed without partial fan-out when the cap is exceeded.
Create deterministic tenant-bound notification keys in the existing operational_alert_notification_outbox using in_app and active_tenant_members only.

Reconcile pending tenant-bound capability outbox rows when the alert resolves, severity drops, verification becomes stale, sync identity changes, or the tenant no longer has active membership authority.
Return bounded fan-out diagnostics while keeping alert persistence successful when fan-out target resolution is skipped fail-closed.
assertions: Capability drift requires age_escalation policy capability_drift_age_escalation_v1 and blocker_age_hours >= 24 before notification eligibility.
The persisted effective severity, not the original live candidate severity, controls capability notification eligibility.
Only active tenants with at least one active membership become fan-out targets.
More than 1000 active tenant targets produces skipped_fail_closed with no partial tenant_ids.
Notification keys are tenant-bound, deterministic, unique-safe, and no longer than the existing 255-character column.
Capability fan-out uses channel=in_app and recipient_scope=active_tenant_members; email, webhook, provider calls, and external sends are not introduced.
One global operational_alerts row remains authoritative; no per-tenant alert rows or new tables are added.
No Migration, tenant mutation endpoint, managed repair execution, Production action, secret read, rebase, or force push is introduced.
